rows.details: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC), New Delhi, on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: The National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi and issues this Terms of Reference on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The Senior Consultant (LSCM) will work with the Central TB Division (CTD) on the procurement and supply chain of drugs, lab consumables and other programme logistics.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.A / B.Sc. / B.Com. / BBA / B.Tech. from a recognized University with MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in Supply Chain Management. 5-7 years' experience in managing supply chain of drugs & other commodities. Working knowledge of computers. Preference will be given for experience in any public health Programme at National/ State Level. The age limit for the Senior Consultant (LSCM) post is upto 65 years, and the candidate must be ready to travel extensively. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates can refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration range for the Senior Consultant (LSCM) is between Rs. 1,00,000/- and Rs. 1,55,000/- per month. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis; the notice does not mention the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The responsibilities of the Senior Consultant (LSCM), as printed in the Terms of Reference, are: To maintain and update the international/ national/ regional data base of manufacturers/ suppliers of drugs, lab consumables and other program logistics. To prepare documents for national level procurement including invitation for national/international competitive bids, Direct Shopping or Direct Purchase on a case to case basis. To assist Central TB Division in conducting pre and post procurement quality assessment. To prepare report on national procurement. To track and review the periodic procurement reports from the states/districts and provide feedback. Monitoring and evaluation of state/district level procurements based on the state/district annual action plans. Monitor the performance of manufacturers/suppliers in preventive maintenance of equipment under warranty and initiate statutory procedures on non-compliance. Monitor the states for timely engagement/ renewal of contracts of agencies for preventive maintenance of equipment. To ensure timely action by the states/districts to prevent expiries by monitoring stocks at each stocking point in collaboration with the SC manager. To train the state program managers and state nodal officers for PSM in collaboration with the SC manager. To conduct supervisory visits to state/district stores. To facilitate change management with respect to use of ICT & Nikshay tools for concerned data entry, validation & its use for public health action. Any other relevant job as and when assigned by CTD.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates are requested to fill in the online application correctly; the form is available on the NHSRC website (nhsrcindia.org). Applications will be accepted in the prescribed online application format only, and the last date for receiving applications is 30 November 2026. The notice does not list any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: If the recruitment process includes a written test, a minimum qualifying mark will be 70%. Applications in any format other than the prescribed online application are not accepted. The candidate must be ready to travel extensively, including supervisory visits to state/district stores.
